test_case.purpose: On one explicitly approved GPU/IP component, inject one vendor-proven block2/type4 fatal event, decode a fresh target-specific table6.3 Fatal/MCE record or persistent equivalent, and complete controlled GPU/host recovery without retry.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build and AMD GPU RAS guide table6.3 revision
Engineering decision: GFX as command/sample or SDMA as Script path, plus corrected Fatal wording
Device1-specific pre-decode freshness baseline and expected raw Fatal/MCE fields
Containment/reset deadlines, persistent OOB evidence and rehearsed GPU/host recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute while component/severity/baseline conflicts remain. After approval, bind the exact UUID/BDF to the corrected component tuple, capture device1 decode/log/persistent baselines and OOB readiness, inject once, decode if available, preserve fatal evidence and follow the approved recovery with no repeat.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authorized GPU/component records the signed fresh table6.3-compatible Fatal/MCE event and raw identity fields; containment/reset follows policy, persistent evidence survives any in-band loss, and recovery restores host plus all-GPU topology, health and representative workload.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until component, Fatal semantics, explicit target and freshness baseline are approved. Wrong IP/device, copied Correctable result, stale/sample-only decode, missing persistent cause, unapproved reset, wedge/boot failure or incomplete restoration fails/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle GPU/host with serial/OOB, recoverable boot path and platform owner present.
No shared amdgpu reload or forensic clear without approval.
One explicit UUID/BDF target and one fatal injection once.
Never retry after reset, hang or evidence loss; recover independently.
expected_evidence: GFX/SDMA and Fatal/Correctable engineering resolution plus tool/guide provenance
UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/device1/component mapping and idle driver/firmware baseline
Device1 pre-decode cursor, persistent logs and OOB readiness
Exact one-shot tuple transcript and fresh Fatal/MCE raw decode or persistent equivalent
Recovery/boot, all-GPU topology/health/workload, restoration diff and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve first fatal and persistent records, use only the approved OOB/reset/reboot path, restore driver/tool/debug state and verify host plus every GPU's topology, memory and workload. Do not repeat the fatal event if decoding/evidence is incomplete.
